name: Video editor
description: Plan and produce short videos with FFmpeg, measured audio, safe captions and optional HyperFrames motion.

skills.name: video_editor_plan
skills.description: Plan sourced hooks, beats, exact speech, production intent and verifiable acceptance checks.

skills.name: video_editor_inspect
skills.description: Inspect measured media and validate timeline/caption bounds.

skills.name: video_editor_edit
skills.description: Render FFmpeg cuts, still camera moves, fades, audio tracks and timed captions.

skills.name: video_editor_spec
skills.description: Exact JSON schemas, examples, limits and failure semantics for the pack tools.

skills.name: video_editor_hyperframes
skills.description: Build seekable HyperFrames HTML motion and run local checks, snapshots and renders.

tools.name: probe
tools.description: Inspect real codecs, canvas, audio streams and duration with host-bound FFprobe.

path.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

tools.name: validate
tools.description: Validate timeline JSON, measured asset ranges, caption timing and safe-area glyph bounds before rendering.

spec.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

tools.name: render
tools.description: Render a JSON timeline to H.264 MP4; image zooms, trims, fades, explicit audio mix and Vietnamese-safe captions. Source clip audio requires explicit audio track.

spec.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

output.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

tools.name: contact_sheet
tools.description: Decode 1..12 selected frames of a final video into a PNG contact sheet. Zero decoded samples is a failure.

path.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

output.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

tools.name: hyperframes
tools.description: Run fixed actions of a separately installed pinned HyperFrames CLI on an authored project. No arbitrary argv, package installs, publish or cloud actions.

output.description: Clean path relative to host FILE_ROOT. Output parents must exist; outputs must be new.

FILE_ROOT.title: Thư mục làm việc
FILE_ROOT.description: Thư mục làm việc của cuộc trò chuyện. Nest cấp tự động; công cụ chỉ đọc và ghi tệp trong thư mục này.

PYTHON_EXECUTABLE.title: Python của máy chủ
PYTHON_EXECUTABLE.description: Đường dẫn tuyệt đối tới trình Python đã cài sẵn thư viện của pack (xem README). Máy chủ đặt biến môi trường SOOT_MEDIA_PYTHON.

VIDEO_BINDING.title: FFmpeg của máy chủ
VIDEO_BINDING.description: JSON chứa đường dẫn tuyệt đối tới ffmpeg và ffprobe. Máy chủ đặt biến môi trường SOOT_VIDEO_BINDING; mẫu trong README.

HYPERFRAMES_BINDING.title: HyperFrames
HYPERFRAMES_BINDING.description: JSON chứa đường dẫn tuyệt đối tới node và CLI HyperFrames đã cài; chỉ cần cho công cụ hyperframes. Máy chủ đặt biến môi trường SOOT_HYPERFRAMES_BINDING.
